Streaming chat completion with multiple choice outputs (n > 1)

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "Hello", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4o", "n" => 2, "stream" => true]));
$chunks = iterator_to_array(LiterLlm::chatStream($req));
```
